test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A shopkeeper has the following 2 schemes.

(I) Two successive discounts of 15% and 20%

(II) Buy 5, get 4 free

The single discount from each scheme, respectively, is:
solution:
GIVEN:

2 schemes offered by shopkeepers.

FORMULA USED:

S.P. = ( 1-d1/100) × ( 1-d2/100) × M.P. 

Where, S.P. = Selling price , M.P. = Marked price , d1 and d2 = successive discounts respectively.

CALCULATION:

Scheme I. Two successive discounts of 20% and 15%

So, effective discount for scheme I is = 20 + 15 - (20 × 15)/100 = 35 - 3 = 32%

Scheme II. Buy 5 get 4 free

So, effective discount for scheme II is = (Article get free)/(Total articles) × 100 = 4/(5 + 4) × 100 = 44.44%

**The answer is 32%, 44.44%.**
